## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link a related issue if applicable.

## Verification

Describe what you checked, the result, and any account or platform you could
not check. Use sanitized examples; live paid AI calls are not required.

## Checklist

- [ ] Changes are focused and follow the existing style.
- [ ] Documentation reflects any behavior or setup changes.
- [ ] No credentials, browser sessions, local study data, or generated files are included.
- [ ] Any added third-party material has a source, attribution, and compatible license.
